sn6.4:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2.
sn6.4:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena Bakassa brahmuno evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti || ||
sn6.4:1.4: Idaṃ niccaṃ idaṃ dhuvaṃ || idaṃ sassataṃ idaṃ kevalaṃ idam acavanadhammaṃ || idaṃ hi na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na uppajjati || ito ca pan-aññam uttariṃ nissaraṇaṃ natthīti || || 3.
sn6.4:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Bakassa brahmuno cetasā cetoparivitakkam aññāya seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya || evam eva Jetavane antarahito tasmiṃ brahmaloke pātur ahosi || || 4.
sn6.4:2.2: Addasā kho Bako brahmā Bhagavantam dūrato va āgacchantaṃ ||
sn6.4:2.4: Ehi kho mārisa svāgataṃ te mārisa
sn6.4:2.5: cirassaṃ kho mārisa imaṃ pariyāyam akāsi yad idaṃ idhāgamanāya || ||
sn6.4:2.6: Idaṃ hi mārisa niccam idaṃ dhuvam idaṃ sassatam idaṃ kevalam idam acavanadhammaṃ || idaṃ hi na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na uppajjati || ito ca pan-aññaṃ uttariṃ nissaraṇaṃ natthī ti || || 5.
sn6.4:3.1: Evaṃ vutte Bhagavā Bakam brahmānam idam avoca || ||
sn6.4:3.2: Avijjāgato vata bho Bako brahmā avijjāgato vata bho Bako brahmā || ||
sn6.4:3.3: Yatra hi nāma aniccam yeva samānaṃ niccan ti vakkhati || adhuvaṃ yeva samānaṃ dhuvan-ti vakkhati || Asassataṃ yeva samānaṃ sassatan ti vakkhati || akevalaṃ yeva samānaṃ kevalan ti vakkhati || cavanadhammaṃ yeva samānaṃ acavana-dhamman ti vakkhati || ||
sn6.4:3.4: Yattha ca pana jayati ca jīyati ca mīyati ca cavati ca uppajjati ca taṃ ca tathā vakkhati
sn6.4:3.5: idaṃ hi na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na uppajjati
sn6.4:3.6: santañ ca pan-aññam uttariṃ nissaraṇaṃ n-atth-aññaṃ uttariṃ nissaraṇan-ti vakkhatī ti || || 6.
sn6.4:5.1: hi etaṃ na hi dīgham āyu ||
sn6.4:5.2: yaṃ tvaṃ Baka maññasi dīgham āyu ||
sn6.4:6.4: ācikkha me taṃ yam ahaṃ vijaññā || || 9.
sn6.4:11.4: obhāsayaṃ tiṭṭhati brahmalokan ti || || 1. Sāvatthi nidānaṃ || || 2.
